fields.statement: Verified at 3f47460c6 (attempt 2) in a detached checkout. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipLand -v: all PASS, including TestShipLandNodeChangedMergesMain (head build exiting 3 with 'cannot land change set X: node N changed' returns CodeConflict naming node N and the conflicted file and records the merge conflict) and TestShipLandOtherHeadFailureStaysPlain (other message / other exit stay a plain land failure with the head build's detail; TestShipLandHeadBuildErrorDetail also passes). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-land-conflict$': ok; the script runs ship-change with fake gh through land fail -> land-triage -> land-conflict-triage -> land-main-conflict-triage pass -> conflict-fix -> land visit 2 pass, and case 2 fails with no fixer. The cycle-1 blocker (actors shared across sessions stopping runs at build/check) no longer reproduces at this head.
